nom: TONYMOLY I'm Rice Makeup Melting Cleansing Oil

avis.texte: I looked at Ulta for an inexpensive oil for a first cleanse after my old makeup remover started irritating my skin, and this one is great! I don't notice the smell that other reviewers mention, and I do feel like it removes makeup and rinses clean to leave skin fairly hydrated. I use 2 pumps a night to remove a full face of makeup plus sunscreen, and I'm only halfway through the bottle after about 4 months. Zero complaints!

This product leaves your skin feeling like there is oil in your pores and does not remove all of your makeup even with a second cleaning step. Plus, it irritated my eyes so bad and made them red, itchy, and sting for a while. I had to continue to gently do cold water presses on my eyes.

If you are sensitive to smells, this is not the product for you. It smells like old fryer oil. It works beautifully and my skin feels great, but the smell is so offputting that I cant continue using it.

cost effective cleansing oil that does not sting my eyes! I don't wear heavy face makeup, I focus mainly on my eyes and a lot of cleansing oils make my eyes/eyelids sting but so far this one has not caused any irritation! I only use 1-2 pumps for my whole face and I can see this lasting me a few months at least
Love how this profuct feels on my face ! I just hate the smell. It seems like expired make-up 😞

I was Gifted By Tony Moly and I've really been enjoying using the Rice Makeup Melting Cleansing Oil. It's quickly become one of my favorite steps in my routine. The texture is silky and lightweight, and it melts away makeup effortlessly without leaving any greasy residue. After rinsing, my skin feels soft, hydrated, and completely clean, not tight or stripped. I love that the formula includes hypoallergenic rice extract and PHAs for gentle exfoliation because it helps keep my skin smooth and bright while still being super gentle on my sensitive skin. Overall, it's a soothing, effective cleanser that makes double cleansing feel like a treat!

Easy to use! Perfect to use as a double cleanser. It helps to remove my makeup and also provide a thorough cleanse. The oil feels gentle and not overly greasy. There is a pump dispenser and also a clip to help with any spillage. Gifted by Tonymoly.

Love this cleansing oil! Makes my skin so clean after makeup and SPF, also after cleansing my skin is so soft and smooth , really love how soft my skin is after! Definitely recommend for everyday using! Got it complimentary from TONYMOLY

I really liked this rice, water cleansing oil. It really removed a lot of of my makeup off my face and left my face feeling very soft and hydrated. I definitely recommend recommended if you are in the market for looking for a product like this. Complimentary from tonymoly

I love this makeup removing cleanser! It is so gentle yet effective at removing even my waterproof mascara! I apply it to my face dry and then rinse after massaging all over my face for at-least 15 seconds. It rinses well and you wouldn't even have to double cleanse if you didn't want to. This product was gifted by TonyMoly in exchange for my honest review.

Using an oil based pre cleanse in your skin care routine is such a game changer. I like the fact that this Tony Moly I'm Rice has good skin care properties and my skin feels so hydrated and calm after each use. My skin has also become brighter with each use. Gifted by tonymoly

I love this makeup melting cleansing oil! It's so gentle on my skin and leaves my skin feeling soft and nourished. It does an amazing job of getting all of my makeup off. I love that there's no artificial coloring or fragrance. A must have! Gifted by tonymoly.

The Melting Cleansing Oil has a silky, lightweight texture that glides effortlessly over the skin, melting away makeup. It feels smooth and gentle during use. After rinsing, my skin feels clean yet hydrated! #giftedbytonymoly

I received this cleansing oil complimentary from tonymoly and have had a great experience with it. My skin is a bit sensitive and tends to be on the drier side. This took my makeup off easily without stripping my skin and actually leaving it softer than before!

Complimentary from tonymoly. This MELTS makeup in the best way. I love the texture and how it does not leave you face feeling stripped at all. I'm such a fan on tonymoly and this is yet again another winner in my eyes.
